senses.gloss: to ask someone for professional advice or information

definition_translations.zh_TW: 向某人尋求專業建議或資訊
definition_translations.ja_JP: 専門的な助言や情報を人に求める
definition_translations.vi_VN: hỏi ai đó để lấy lời khuyên chuyên môn hoặc thông tin
definition_translations.th_TH: ขอคำแนะนำหรือข้อมูลทางวิชาชีพจากใครบางคน

senses.gloss: to discuss something with others before deciding
senses.example: Management will consult employees before changing the schedule.

translations.vi_VN: thảo luận; tham khảo ý kiến
translations.th_TH: ปรึกษาหารือ

example_translations.zh_TW: 管理層會在變更排班前與員工協商。
example_translations.ja_JP: 経営陣はスケジュールを変更する前に従業員と協議します。
example_translations.ko_KR: 경영진은 일정을 변경하기 전에 직원들과 상의할 것입니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Ban quản lý sẽ tham khảo ý kiến nhân viên trước khi thay đổi lịch làm việc.
example_translations.th_TH: ฝ่ายบริหารจะปรึกษาพนักงานก่อนเปลี่ยนตารางงาน

definition_translations.zh_TW: 在決定前與他人討論某事
definition_translations.ja_JP: 決定する前に他の人と話し合う
definition_translations.vi_VN: thảo luận điều gì với người khác trước khi quyết định
definition_translations.th_TH: หารือบางสิ่งกับผู้อื่นก่อนตัดสินใจ

senses.gloss: to look at a source of information for guidance
senses.example: Please consult the manual before installing the equipment.

translations.th_TH: เปิดดู; อ้างอิง

example_translations.zh_TW: 安裝設備前，請先查閱手冊。
example_translations.ja_JP: 機器を設置する前に、マニュアルを参照してください。
example_translations.ko_KR: 장비를 설치하기 전에 설명서를 참조해 주세요.
example_translations.vi_VN: Vui lòng tham khảo sách hướng dẫn trước khi lắp đặt thiết bị.
example_translations.th_TH: โปรดดูคู่มือก่อนติดตั้งอุปกรณ์

definition_translations.zh_TW: 查閱資訊來源以取得指引
definition_translations.ja_JP: 手引きとして情報源を見る
definition_translations.ko_KR: 지침을 얻기 위해 정보 출처를 보다
definition_translations.vi_VN: xem nguồn thông tin để được hướng dẫn
definition_translations.th_TH: ดูแหล่งข้อมูลเพื่อเป็นแนวทาง

translations.th_TH: ปรึกษาทนายความ

translations.vi_VN: tham khảo ý kiến chuyên gia
translations.th_TH: ปรึกษาผู้เชี่ยวชาญ
